boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-purchase activities for spending time together on campus or around Seaside, with eligibility and scheduling limits noted.

cards.title: Browse the Library Together
cards.subtitle: Books, periodicals, and reference materials in Building 508
cards.notes: Meet inside Building 508, choose a shared topic, and browse the stacks together; ask staff about a free public library card if needed.
cards.short_summary: A low-key group browse through CSUMB’s physical collections with free services available even to unaffiliated visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSUMB Library states that the general public may consult its books, periodicals, and reference materials and lists these among its free services.
cards.source_title: General Public | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Free services are available to the general public; borrowing requires a library card and photo ID.

cards.title: Share an Open-Swim Session
cards.subtitle: No-cost pool time for currently enrolled Otters
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule, bring swim gear, and meet for open swimming; confirm the latest session before walking over to the pool.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled pool meetup for enrolled students who want an active, purchase-free break.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB says the Aquatics Center offers open swim and is free to all currently enrolled students.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Center | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Currently enrolled students enter at no cost. Open-swim dates and hours change; verify the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Make Something Side by Side
cards.subtitle: Tools, materials, and learning opportunities in the library
cards.notes: Join the Makerspace group, complete its waiver, and pick a small project to create together using the available shared resources.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on collaborative session built around the Makerspace’s free tools, materials, and maker activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The official CSUMB Library Makerspace group lists free access to tools, materials, and educational opportunities as a membership benefit.
cards.access_notes: CSUMB Makerspace membership and acceptance of its waiver are required; access to listed tools, materials, and opportunities is free.

cards.title: Take an MST Ride Together
cards.subtitle: A fare-free local outing using the OtterCard benefit
cards.notes: Bring your OtterCard, choose a current MST route, and ride with friends to a public stop; check the agency schedule before departure.
cards.short_summary: A student-card outing that turns the regional bus network into a no-fare way to explore together.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB identifies a free pass for Monterey-Salinas Transit buses as an OtterCard benefit.
cards.source_title: OtterCard | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: A valid OtterCard is required for the free-pass benefit; consult current MST routes and service notices before traveling.

cards.title: Ride the Wave Around Campus
cards.subtitle: A free OtterCard shuttle loop for an easy campus meetup
cards.notes: Meet at a marked shuttle stop with your OtterCards and ride a campus loop together; consult the current transportation map first.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed, mobility-friendly campus circuit aboard CSUMB’s student shuttle.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB lists a free pass to ride the campus shuttle among the benefits attached to the OtterCard.
cards.source_title: OtterCard | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Bring a valid OtterCard and verify the current Wave route, operating dates, and stop information before meeting.

cards.title: Cheer at an Otter Home Game
cards.subtitle: Student admission covered through the OtterCard
cards.notes: Pick a home contest from the official athletics schedule, bring your OtterCard, and meet outside the listed venue before entry.
cards.short_summary: A school-spirited group outing to a scheduled CSUMB home contest without a separate student ticket purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB lists free entry to Otter Athletics games as an OtterCard benefit.
cards.source_title: OtterCard | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Valid OtterCard holders receive free entry; confirm the current home schedule, venue, and any event-specific entry rules.

cards.title: Plan a Free Bike Outing
cards.subtitle: Student bike rentals and safety resources on campus
cards.notes: Visit the Cycle Center with your student ID, ask about an available rental, and choose a route suited to everyone’s riding ability.
cards.short_summary: A student bike meetup supported by the campus Cycle Center’s free rentals and riding resources.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB Student Life states that the Otter Cycle Center offers free bike rentals, repairs, and safety resources to CSUMB students.
cards.source_title: Student Life | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Free rentals are for CSUMB students and depend on operating hours and bicycle availability; ask staff about current checkout requirements.

cards.title: Browse Reuse Supplies Together
cards.subtitle: Free supplies through CSUMB’s campus sustainability program
cards.notes: Stop by together, look through the available reused supplies, and take only items you can put to use; availability naturally varies.
cards.short_summary: A practical sustainability hang centered on selecting useful free materials from CSUMB’s reuse supply program.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB’s Sustainability page directs campus community members to pick up free supplies at Second Wave Supplies.
cards.source_title: Sustainability | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: The supplies are free; confirm the program’s current location, operating access, and available inventory before going.

cards.title: Learn CPR with a Classmate
cards.subtitle: No-cost scheduled safety training at Stillwell CDC
cards.notes: Register when enrollment opens, arrive early with a classmate, and complete the four-hour Heartsaver course together for certification.
cards.short_summary: A structured social learning session covering CPR and AED use while earning a two-year Heartsaver certificate.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB states that its CPR and AED classes are available at no cost to students, faculty, staff, and University Corporation employees.
cards.source_title: CPR and AED Training | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Advance registration is needed to secure a free reserved seat. Unreserved walk-ins may face a $25 fee after capacity is reached.

cards.entity_name: Otter Days Beginner Mountain Bike Ride
cards.title: Join the Beginner Mountain Bike Ride
cards.subtitle: A free guided Otter Days ride from the Cycle Center
cards.notes: Register for the Otter Days beginner ride, wear comfortable gear, and meet at the Cycle Center ready for a gentle group pace.
cards.short_summary: A guided social ride designed for new mountain bikers, with no participation charge and equipment support noted.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Otter Days page describes Recreation’s Beginner Mountain Bike Ride as free and separately states that a helmet and bike rental are provided for its free mountain-bike clinic.
cards.source_title: Otter Days | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Offered during Otter Days on scheduled dates; verify registration, event eligibility, equipment arrangements, and the current event calendar.

warnings: Several activities are limited to current CSUMB students or valid OtterCard holders; restrictions are stated in access_notes.
Seasonal programs, facility schedules, equipment availability, and transit service should be reconfirmed on the linked direct sources.
